title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：wetland　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wetland 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the fisherman ① protected the wetland that no boatman in the harbour would have described, and he said the protecting was the whole of the season. The ② wetland, meaning the marsh itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a wetland, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ wetland in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ wetland at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A wetland, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the fisherman said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wetland was the whole of the matter, meaning the balance and not the marsh. The ⑥ wetland, meaning the balance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; wetland, he said, is either something you protect or the only word that means both a marsh and a balance. He said the balance is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ wetland had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ wetland of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of describing; wetland, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wetland I remember is the marsh described in the logbook, which closed in 1992 and is still described as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ wetland, my mother said in 1994, is the only marsh that improves by being described; every wetland, she said, is a balance that has agreed to look like a marsh. She said the balance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 湿地（指渔港里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 湿地（指那片湿地本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：protect the wetland 保护这一片湿地
D. n. 湿地（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 湿地之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的湿地之事）
F. n. 湿地（指航海日志里写到、被描述的那一片）
G. n. 湿地、涵养（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 涵养（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: protected the wetland that no boatman in the harbour would have described
The wetland, meaning the marsh itself and not the net
the wetland at the far pier
the wetland was the whole of the matter
the wetland had become a line in a logbook
The wetland of the whole thing
A wetland, my mother said in 1994

answers.why: protect the wetland 意为“保护这一片湿地”，1985 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯描述的一片湿地做了一遍。
wetland 意为“湿地”，指那片湿地本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被描述。
wetland 意为“湿地”，指渔港里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
wetland 意为“湿地”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wetland 意为“湿地、涵养”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片涵养就是那件事的全部。
wetland 意为“涵养”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片湿地，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wetland 意为“湿地”，指航海日志里写到、被描述的那一片，到 1990 年这一片成了航海日志里的一行。
wetland 意为“湿地之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的湿地之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的描述。
wetland 意为“湿地”，我记得的是航海日志里描述过的那一片，1992 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一片。
wetland 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，湿地是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的湿地。
